description: Ministry of Home Affairs - The Public and Bank Holidays for the Year - 2017
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister of Home Affairs exercising powers under the Holidays Act (No. 29 of 1971) to declare public and bank holidays for 2017. This constitutes a regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the minister's name is incidental to the regulatory function being performed.
